rows.notes: The study is a qualitative review/analysis of CSR reports of five coffee companies combined with a literature review on climate adaptation and CSR theory; it reports no original experimental, survey or measured data. It never mentions drip or sensor-based irrigation; it only lists 'improved soil and water management' and 'improving water collection and management' as generic adaptation options drawn from other sources. No own evidence on drip irrigation as a drought-risk-management measure.

notes: Document is a desk-based review/discussion article (CSR document analysis and literature review), not a primary study; it does not address drip or sensor-based irrigation at all.
